starting-coins.description: The amount of gold the player starts with

starting-lifes.description: Indicates the starting health of the player at the beginning of the game

extra-lifes-prices.description: Comma-separated prices for extra lives. Leave blank to use default settings.

description-text.description: A short story or overview of the map displayed to the player before starting.

tile-size.description: The fixed pixel size of a single map tile. This value is constant and cannot be changed.

difficulty.description: Represents the map's challenge level, typically indicated by star icons or difficulty names.
